subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit period clarification
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit period clarification

Hi Jane,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our procurement/security team as we move toward contract signature. Can you please share the following for Acme's evaluation?

1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the most recent audit period.
2) Any bridge letter or attestation if the report's audit window doesn't cover the past 30 days.
3) Confirmation of the audit period start/end dates and whether the report covers subservice organizations (if applicable).

To make this easy, I attached a short one-page "coverage ask" (redwood-soc2-coverage-ask.pdf) and a set of one-line reply templates you can paste back to us. If preferred, we can accept a presigned S3 link or secure Drive share.

Two small notes that speed review on our side:
- If your SOC 2 report is older than 12 months, a bridge letter explaining interim controls is helpful.
- If you redact vendor names/operational details, include a short manifest of what was redacted so our security team can triage.

Timeline: would you be able to share these assets by end-of-week (Fri 9/19)? If not, a short note with expected delivery is fine.

Thanks so much — feel free to reply to this thread or send to sec-ops@redwood.com.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-soc2-coverage-ask.pdf; soc2-quick-replies.txt

From: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@acme-corp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Ops <sec-ops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit period clarification

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear note. Quick answers inline: 

- We have a SOC 2 Type II report dated 2025-04-01 covering the period 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31.
- We do not have a bridge letter on file for gaps after 12/31/2024; procurement can request an auditor-issued bridge if needed (we can ask).
- Subservice orgs: we use CloudPartner Inc for infra — it's noted in section 3.2 of the report.

We can provide: SOC2_TypeII_Acme_2024.pdf. We normally share via our secure SFTP or a presigned S3 link. Which do you prefer?

If you'd like, I can also complete the one-line reply templates you sent and return those to you.

-Jane
Jane Ellis
Head of Security & Compliance
Acme Corp
attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Acme_2024.pdf (will send via secure link)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit period clarification

Thanks, Jane — SFTP or presigned S3 both work. Presigned S3 is slightly faster on our intake side; if that's easiest, a 7-day expiry link is fine.

Two follow-ups from our security reviewer (Karthik is cc'd):
- Can you confirm whether the report includes system descriptions for the product modules Redwood will use (API layer + inference runtime)? If those are redacted, a short manifest is fine.
- If you do not have a bridge letter, would the auditor be willing to issue a limited-scope bridge covering the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-09-30? If that's not feasible we can accept a scripted attestation from your security team and escalate to our procurement.

I've attached the one-line reply templates again (soc2-quick-replies.txt) — feel free to fill and paste one back. If you prefer, I can create a small DocuSign consent for sharing and send it now; that often speeds approvals.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — appreciate it.

Best,
Grace
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
attachments: soc2-quick-replies.txt

From: Jane Ellis <jane.ellis@acme-corp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Ops <sec-ops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter — audit period clarification

Grace — sending the presigned link now. Link: https://acme-presigned.s3.amazonaws.com/SOC2_TypeII_Acme_2024.pdf?X-Amz-Expires=604800

Quick notes we added to the file manifest at the top of the PDF: 
- Sections with vendor-specific IP redactions are marked; these are limited to network diagrams in Appendix B.
- System descriptions include the API gateway and inference runtime; identity sections reference our IAM provider.

On the bridge letter: our auditor can produce a short bridge letter but it requires a signed engagement (we can route internally). If you need that before contract sig, tell me and I'll open the engagement with our auditor (likely a 5–7 business day turnaround).

One-line reply (used from your template):
"SOC2_TypeII_Acme_2024.pdf shared via presigned S3; audit period 2024-01-01 — 2024-12-31. Bridge letter available from auditor on request (5–7 business days)."

Let me know if you need anything else.

Thanks,
Jane
Head of Security & Compliance
Acme Corp
attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Acme_2024.pdf (presigned link)
